Definition: to flow forth (literally or figuratively); by implication, to liquify
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pour out or forth, drop (or rain), be poured, be poured out, be melted, be molten; 1a) (Qal) to pour forth; 1b) (Niphal) to be poured, be poured out; 1c) (Hiphil) to pour out, melt; 1d) (Hophal) to be melted
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
